import json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path

# NDJSON from stdin
rows=[]
buf=sys.stdin.read()
dec=json.JSONDecoder()
i=0
while i &lt; len(buf):
    while i &lt; len(buf) and buf[i].isspace():
        i+=1
    if i&gt;=len(buf): break
    obj,end=dec.raw_decode(buf,i)
    rows.append(obj)
    i=end

ROOT=Path(&#39;content/english/blog&#39;)

def draftish(p):
    name=Path(p).name
    return name.startswith(&#39;__&#39;) or name==&#39;_index.md&#39;

# scoreboard
scored=sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r.get(&#39;total_per100w&#39;,0))
over=[r for r in scored if r.get(&#39;total_per100w&#39;,0)&gt;2.0]
near=[r for r in scored if 1.0 &lt; r.get(&#39;total_per100w&#39;,0) &lt;= 2.0]
pub=[r for r in scored if not draftish(r[&#39;file&#39;])]
drafts=[r for r in scored if draftish(r[&#39;file&#39;]) and Path(r[&#39;file&#39;]).name!=&#39;_index.md&#39;]

print(&#39;=== SCORE SUMMARY ===&#39;)
print(f&#39;total scored: {len(scored)}&#39;)
print(f&#39;published: {len(pub)}  drafts: {len(drafts)}&#39;)
print(f&#39;over 2.0 per100w (fail target): {len(over)}&#39;)
print(f&#39;1.0-2.0 per100w: {len(near)}&#39;)
avg=sum(r[&#39;total_per100w&#39;] for r in scored)/len(scored)
avg_pub=sum(r[&#39;total_per100w&#39;] for r in pub)/len(pub) if pub else 0
print(f&#39;avg all={avg:.2f}  avg published={avg_pub:.2f}&#39;)
print(&#39;\nWorst 15 (all):&#39;)
for r in scored[:15]:
    tag=&#39;DRAFT&#39; if draftish(r[&#39;file&#39;]) else &#39;LIVE&#39;
    print(f&#34;  {r[&#39;total_per100w&#39;]:.2f}  {tag}  {Path(r[&#39;file&#39;]).name}  words={r[&#39;words&#39;]}&#34;)
print(&#39;\nWorst live:&#39;)
for r in sorted(pub, key=lambda x:-x[&#39;total_per100w&#39;])[:10]:
    print(f&#34;  {r[&#39;total_per100w&#39;]:.2f}  {Path(r[&#39;file&#39;]).name}  words={r[&#39;words&#39;]}&#34;)

# qualitative gates
GRAT_OPEN=re.compile(r&#39;\b(glad|grateful|thankful|thanks|appreciate|lucky|grateful|I\&#39;m glad|I am glad|kept|still works|earned)\b&#39;, re.I)
GRAT_CLOSE_WEAK=re.compile(r&#39;(hope this helps|thanks for reading|happy reading|let me know|what do you think)&#39;, re.I)
BOTTOM=re.compile(r&#39;^##\s+Bottom line\b&#39;, re.M|re.I)
FURTHER=re.compile(r&#39;^##\s+Further reading\b&#39;, re.M|re.I)
CURRENCY=re.compile(r&#39;(\$\d|₱|\bPHP\s*\d|\bpesos?\b|\bdollars?\b)&#39;, re.I)
USERS_SHOULD=re.compile(r&#39;\busers should\b|\bit is recommended\b&#39;, re.I)
TEMPLATE_IMG=re.compile(r&#39;image-template\.jpg&#39;)
EXPANDED=re.compile(r&#39;Expanded from|Idea captured from ideas\.jorap\.com&#39;)
EMDASH=re.compile(r&#39;[—–]&#39;)
FIRST_I=re.compile(r&#39;\b(I|I\&#39;ve|I\&#39;m|my|me)\b&#39;)

issues=[]
thin=[]
no_level=[]
outliney=[]

for path in sorted(ROOT.glob(&#39;*.md&#39;)):
    if path.name==&#39;_index.md&#39;: continue
    text=path.read_text(encoding=&#39;utf-8&#39;)
    # frontmatter
    if text.startswith(&#39;---&#39;):
        parts=text.split(&#39;---&#39;,2)
        fm=parts[1] if len(parts)&gt;=3 else &#39;&#39;
        body=parts[2] if len(parts)&gt;=3 else text
    else:
        fm=&#39;&#39;; body=text
    is_draft = path.name.startswith(&#39;__&#39;) or re.search(r&#39;^draft:\s*true\b&#39;, fm, re.M)
    live = not path.name.startswith(&#39;__&#39;) and not re.search(r&#39;^draft:\s*true\b&#39;, fm, re.M)

    # level_depth
    if not re.search(r&#39;^level_depth:\s*[1-5]\b&#39;, fm, re.M):
        no_level.append(path.name)

    # word count body
    words=len(re.findall(r&#34;[A-Za-z0-9&#39;]+&#34;, body))
    if words &lt; 80 and live:
        thin.append((path.name, words, &#39;LIVE&#39;))
    elif words &lt; 80:
        thin.append((path.name, words, &#39;draft&#39;))

    # publish blockers
    if TEMPLATE_IMG.search(fm) and live:
        issues.append((path.name,&#39;BLOCK&#39;,&#39;image-template.jpg on live&#39;))
    if EXPANDED.search(body) and live:
        issues.append((path.name,&#39;BLOCK&#39;,&#39;Expanded-from footer on live&#39;))
    if USERS_SHOULD.search(body):
        issues.append((path.name,&#39;BLOCK&#39; if live else &#39;warn&#39;, &#39;users should / it is recommended&#39;))
    if words &lt; 80 and live:
        issues.append((path.name,&#39;BLOCK&#39;, f&#39;body under 80 words ({words})&#39;))

    if BOTTOM.search(body):
        issues.append((path.name,&#39;warn&#39;,&#39;## Bottom line&#39;))
    if FURTHER.search(body):
        links=len(re.findall(r&#39;^\s*[-*]\s*\[&#39;, body[FURTHER.search(body).start():FURTHER.search(body).start()+800], re.M))
        # rough: count list links after heading
        chunk=body[FURTHER.search(body).end():]
        next_h=re.search(r&#39;^##\s&#39;, chunk, re.M)
        section=chunk[:next_h.start()] if next_h else chunk[:800]
        nlinks=len(re.findall(r&#39;\[[^\]]+\]\([^)]+\)&#39;, section))
        if nlinks&gt;=3:
            issues.append((path.name,&#39;warn&#39;,f&#39;## Further reading with {nlinks} links&#39;))
    if CURRENCY.search(body):
        # skip style-guide meta posts that mention the rule
        if &#39;no dollar&#39; not in body.lower() and &#39;currency&#39; not in path.name:
            m=CURRENCY.search(body)
            issues.append((path.name,&#39;warn&#39; if not live else &#39;warn&#39;, f&#39;currency-ish: {m.group(0)!r}&#39;))
    if EMDASH.search(body) or EMDASH.search(fm):
        n=len(EMDASH.findall(text))
        issues.append((path.name,&#39;error&#39; if live else &#39;warn&#39;, f&#39;em/en dashes x{n}&#39;))

    # outline smell: many bare bullets, few paragraphs
    paras=[p for p in re.split(r&#39;\n\s*\n&#39;, body.strip()) if p.strip() and not p.strip().startswith(&#39;#&#39;)]
    bullets=len(re.findall(r&#39;^\s*[-*]\s&#39;, body, re.M))
    if bullets&gt;=12 and len([p for p in paras if not p.strip().startswith(&#39;-&#39;) and not p.strip().startswith(&#39;*&#39;)]) &lt; 4:
        outliney.append((path.name, bullets, words, &#39;LIVE&#39; if live else &#39;draft&#39;))

    # gratitude heuristic on live: first 500 and last 500 chars of prose
    if live:
        prose=re.sub(r&#39;```[\s\S]*?```&#39;,&#39;&#39;,body)
        prose=re.sub(r&#39;^#+\s.*$&#39;,&#39;&#39;,prose,flags=re.M)
        prose=re.sub(r&#39;\s+&#39;,&#39; &#39;,prose).strip()
        head=prose[:500]
        tail=prose[-500:] if len(prose)&gt;500 else prose
        if not GRAT_OPEN.search(head):
            issues.append((path.name,&#39;lens&#39;,&#39;open may lack gratitude posture&#39;))
        if GRAT_CLOSE_WEAK.search(tail):
            issues.append((path.name,&#39;BLOCK&#39;,&#39;curtain-call close&#39;))
        # opinion/faith/family/games first-I check via categories
        cats=re.search(r&#39;^categories:\s*\n((?:\s*-\s*.+\n)+)&#39;, fm, re.M)
        cat_blob=cats.group(1).lower() if cats else &#39;&#39;
        tags=re.search(r&#39;^tags:\s*\n((?:\s*-\s*.+\n)+)&#39;, fm, re.M)
        tag_blob=tags.group(1).lower() if tags else &#39;&#39;
        personal=any(x in cat_blob+tag_blob for x in [&#39;opinion&#39;,&#39;faith&#39;,&#39;family&#39;,&#39;game&#39;,&#39;games&#39;,&#39;personal&#39;])
        # also filename heuristics
        if personal or any(x in path.name for x in [&#39;why-i&#39;,&#39;my-son&#39;,&#39;miracle&#39;,&#39;marvel&#39;,&#39;board-game&#39;,&#39;worship&#39;,&#39;dnpap&#39;]):
            first400=prose[:400]
            if not FIRST_I.search(first400):
                issues.append((path.name,&#39;warn&#39;,&#39;no I/my in first 400 chars (personal post)&#39;))

print(&#39;\n=== MISSING level_depth ===&#39;)
print(no_level or &#39;none&#39;)
print(&#39;\n=== THIN (&lt;80 words) ===&#39;)
for t in thin:
    print(f&#39;  {t}&#39;)
print(&#39;\n=== OUTLINE-HEAVY ===&#39;)
for t in outliney:
    print(f&#39;  {t}&#39;)
print(&#39;\n=== ISSUES (live-first) ===&#39;)
live_iss=[i for i in issues if not i[0].startswith(&#39;__&#39;)]
draft_iss=[i for i in issues if i[0].startswith(&#39;__&#39;)]
from collections import Counter
print(&#39;Live issue counts:&#39;, Counter(i[1] for i in live_iss))
print(&#39;Draft issue counts:&#39;, Counter(i[1] for i in draft_iss))
print(&#39;\nLive issues:&#39;)
for i in sorted(live_iss, key=lambda x:(x[1],x[0])):
    print(f&#39;  [{i[1]}] {i[0]}: {i[2]}&#39;)
print(f&#39;\nDraft issues (showing first 40 of {len(draft_iss)}):&#39;)
for i in sorted(draft_iss, key=lambda x:(x[1],x[0]))[:40]:
    print(f&#39;  [{i[1]}] {i[0]}: {i[2]}&#39;)

# recipe posts check fractions
print(&#39;\n=== RECIPE FRACTION / METRIC SPOTCHECK ===&#39;)
recipes=[&#39;instant-pot-arroz-caldo.md&#39;,&#39;instant-pot-chicken-adobo.md&#39;,&#39;set-it-forget-it-arroz-caldo.md&#39;,&#39;__worcestershire-sauce.md&#39;,&#39;__kewpie-mayo.md&#39;]

near=[r for r in scored if 1.0 < r.get('total_per100w',0) <= 2.0]

drafts=[r for r in scored if draftish(r['file']) and Path(r['file']).name!='_index.md']

print(f'1.0-2.0 per100w: {len(near)}')
avg=sum(r['total_per100w'] for r in scored)/len(scored)
avg_pub=sum(r['total_per100w'] for r in pub)/len(pub) if pub else 0
print(f'avg all={avg:.2f}  avg published={avg_pub:.2f}')
print('\nWorst 15 (all):')
for r in scored[:15]:

FURTHER=re.compile(r'^##\s+Further reading\b', re.M|re.I)
CURRENCY=re.compile(r'(\$\d|₱|\bPHP\s*\d|\bpesos?\b|\bdollars?\b)', re.I)
USERS_SHOULD=re.compile(r'\busers should\b|\bit is recommended\b', re.I)
TEMPLATE_IMG=re.compile(r'image-template\.jpg')
EXPANDED=re.compile(r'Expanded from|Idea captured from ideas\.jorap\.com')
EMDASH=re.compile(r'[—–]')
FIRST_I=re.compile(r'\b(I|I\'ve|I\'m|my|me)\b')

issues=[]
thin=[]
no_level=[]
outliney=[]

for path in sorted(ROOT.glob('*.md')):

    if not re.search(r'^level_depth:\s*[1-5]\b', fm, re.M):
        no_level.append(path.name)

    # word count body
    words=len(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9']+", body))
    if words < 80 and live:
        thin.append((path.name, words, 'LIVE'))
    elif words < 80:
        thin.append((path.name, words, 'draft'))

    # publish blockers
    if TEMPLATE_IMG.search(fm) and live:
        issues.append((path.name,'BLOCK','image-template.jpg on live'))
    if EXPANDED.search(body) and live:
        issues.append((path.name,'BLOCK','Expanded-from footer on live'))
    if USERS_SHOULD.search(body):
        issues.append((path.name,'BLOCK' if live else 'warn', 'users should / it is recommended'))
    if words < 80 and live:
        issues.append((path.name,'BLOCK', f'body under 80 words ({words})'))

    if BOTTOM.search(body):
        issues.append((path.name,'warn','## Bottom line'))

        nlinks=len(re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\([^)]+\)', section))

    if bullets>=12 and len([p for p in paras if not p.strip().startswith('-') and not p.strip().startswith('*')]) < 4:
        outliney.append((path.name, bullets, words, 'LIVE' if live else 'draft'))

    # gratitude heuristic on live: first 500 and last 500 chars of prose
    if live:

        head=prose[:500]

        if not GRAT_OPEN.search(head):

        if GRAT_CLOSE_WEAK.search(tail):
            issues.append((path.name,'BLOCK','curtain-call close'))

        cats=re.search(r'^categories:\s*\n((?:\s*-\s*.+\n)+)', fm, re.M)

        tags=re.search(r'^tags:\s*\n((?:\s*-\s*.+\n)+)', fm, re.M)
        tag_blob=tags.group(1).lower() if tags else ''
        personal=any(x in cat_blob+tag_blob for x in ['opinion','faith','family','game','games','personal'])
        # also filename heuristics
        if personal or any(x in path.name for x in ['why-i','my-son','miracle','marvel','board-game','worship','dnpap']):

GRAT_OPEN=re.compile(r"\b(glad|grateful|thankful|appreciate|lucky|I'm glad|I am glad|still have|still works|earned its|kept the|I'm glad)\b", re.I)
GRAT_CLOSE_WEAK=re.compile(r'(hope this helps|thanks for reading|happy reading|let me know in the comments|what do you think\?)', re.I)
BOTTOM=re.compile(r'^##\s+Bottom line\b', re.M|re.I)
FURTHER=re.compile(r'^##\s+Further reading\b', re.M|re.I)
CURRENCY=re.compile(r'(\$\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?|₱\s*\d|\bPHP\s*\d|\b\d+\s*pesos?\b)', re.I)
USERS_SHOULD=re.compile(r'\busers should\b|\bit is recommended\b', re.I)
TEMPLATE_IMG=re.compile(r'image-template\.jpg')
EXPANDED=re.compile(r'Expanded from|Idea captured from ideas\.jorap\.com')
EMDASH=re.compile(r'[—–]')
FIRST_I=re.compile(r"\b(I|I've|I'm|my|me)\b")

issues=[]
thin=[]
no_level=[]
outliney=[]
empty_h2=[]

for path in sorted(ROOT.glob('*.md')):
    if path.name=='_index.md': continue
    text=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    if text.startswith('---'):
        parts=text.split('---',2)
        fm=parts[1] if len(parts)>=3 else ''
        body=parts[2] if len(parts)>=3 else text
    else:
        fm=''; body=text
    live = not path.name.startswith('__') and not re.search(r'^draft:\s*true\b', fm, re.M)

    if not re.search(r'^level_depth:\s*[1-5]\b', fm, re.M):
        no_level.append(path.name)

    words=len(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9']+", body))
    if words < 80:
        thin.append((path.name, words, 'LIVE' if live else 'draft'))

    if TEMPLATE_IMG.search(fm) and live:
        issues.append((path.name,'BLOCK','image-template.jpg on live'))
    if TEMPLATE_IMG.search(fm) and not live:
        issues.append((path.name,'draft','image-template.jpg (ok until publish)'))
    if EXPANDED.search(body):
        issues.append((path.name,'BLOCK' if live else 'draft','Expanded-from / ideas footer'))
    if USERS_SHOULD.search(body):
        issues.append((path.name,'BLOCK' if live else 'warn', 'users should / it is recommended'))
    if words < 80 and live:
        issues.append((path.name,'BLOCK', f'body under 80 words ({words})'))

    if BOTTOM.search(body):
        issues.append((path.name,'warn','## Bottom line'))
    m=FURTHER.search(body)
    if m:
        chunk=body[m.end():]
        next_h=re.search(r'^##\s', chunk, re.M)
        section=chunk[:next_h.start()] if next_h else chunk[:800]
        nlinks=len(re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\([^)]+\)', section))
        if nlinks>=3:
            issues.append((path.name,'warn',f'## Further reading with {nlinks} links'))
    if CURRENCY.search(body):
        m=CURRENCY.search(body)
        issues.append((path.name,'warn', f'currency amount: {m.group(0)!r}'))
    n_em=len(EMDASH.findall(text))
    if n_em:
        issues.append((path.name,'error' if live else 'warn', f'em/en dashes x{n_em}'))

    # empty H2
    for hm in re.finditer(r'^(##\s+[^\n]+)\n+(?=##\s|\Z)', body, re.M):
        empty_h2.append((path.name, hm.group(1).strip()))

    paras=[p for p in re.split(r'\n\s*\n', body.strip()) if p.strip() and not p.strip().startswith('#')]
    bullets=len(re.findall(r'^\s*[-*]\s', body, re.M))
    prose_paras=len([p for p in paras if not re.match(r'^\s*[-*]', p) and not re.match(r'^\s*\d+\.', p)])
    if bullets>=12 and prose_paras < 4 and words>=80:
        outliney.append((path.name, bullets, words, prose_paras, 'LIVE' if live else 'draft'))

    if live:
        prose=re.sub(r'```[\s\S]*?```','',body)
        prose=re.sub(r'^#+\s.*$','',prose,flags=re.M)
        prose=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',prose).strip()
        head=prose[:500]
        tail=prose[-500:] if len(prose)>500 else prose
        if not GRAT_OPEN.search(head):
            issues.append((path.name,'lens','open may lack gratitude posture'))
        if GRAT_CLOSE_WEAK.search(tail):
            issues.append((path.name,'BLOCK','curtain-call close'))
        cats=re.search(r'^categories:\s*\n((?:\s*-\s*.+\n)+)', fm, re.M)
        tags=re.search(r'^tags:\s*\n((?:\s*-\s*.+\n)+)', fm, re.M)
        blob=((cats.group(1) if cats else '')+(tags.group(1) if tags else '')).lower()
        personal=any(x in blob for x in ['opinion','faith','family','game','games','personal'])
        if personal or any(x in path.name for x in ['why-i','my-son','miracle','marvel','board-game','worship','dnpap','hanamikoji','streamlining']):
            if not FIRST_I.search(prose[:400]):
                issues.append((path.name,'warn','no I/my in first 400 chars (personal post)') )

print('\n=== MISSING level_depth ===')
print(no_level or 'none')
print('\n=== THIN (<80 words) ===')
for t in thin:
    print(f'  {t}')
print('\n=== OUTLINE-HEAVY ===')
for t in outliney:
    print(f'  {t}')
print('\n=== EMPTY H2 ===')
for t in empty_h2[:20]:
    print(f'  {t}')
print(f'  ... total empty H2: {len(empty_h2)}')

live_iss=[i for i in issues if not i[0].startswith('__')]
draft_iss=[i for i in issues if i[0].startswith('__')]
print('\n=== ISSUE COUNTS ===')
print('Live:', Counter(i[1] for i in live_iss))
print('Draft:', Counter(i[1] for i in draft_iss))
print('\nLive issues:')
for i in sorted(live_iss, key=lambda x:({'BLOCK':0,'error':1,'warn':2,'lens':3,'draft':4}.get(x[1],9), x[0])):
    print(f'  [{i[1]}] {i[0]}: {i[2]}')
print(f'\nDraft high-priority (BLOCK/error/warn currency/dashes), {sum(1 for i in draft_iss if i[1] in ("BLOCK","error","warn"))} items:')
for i in sorted(draft_iss, key=lambda x:(x[1],x[0])):
    if i[1] in ('BLOCK','error','warn') or (i[1]=='draft' and 'footer' in i[2]):
        print(f'  [{i[1]}] {i[0]}: {i[2]}')

print('\n=== RECIPE UNICODE FRACTIONS ===')
for name in ['instant-pot-arroz-caldo.md','instant-pot-chicken-adobo.md','set-it-forget-it-arroz-caldo.md','__worcestershire-sauce.md','__kewpie-mayo.md']:
    p=ROOT/name
    if not p.exists():
        continue
    t=p.read_text()
    print(f'  {name}: unicode_frac={bool(re.search(r"[½⅓⅔¼¾]", t))}')

import re
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('content/english/blog')

def body_of(p):
    t=p.read_text()
    if t.startswith('---'):
        parts=t.split('---',2)
        return parts[1], parts[2] if len(parts)>=3 else ''
    return '', t

def first_paras(body, n=3):
    # skip blank, get first n non-empty blocks that aren't only headings
    chunks=[]
    for block in re.split(r'\n\s*\n', body.strip()):
        b=block.strip()
        if not b: continue
        if re.match(r'^#+\s', b) and '\n' not in b: continue
        chunks.append(re.sub(r'\s+',' ',b)[:280])
        if len(chunks)>=n: break
    return chunks

def last_paras(body, n=2):
    chunks=[]
    for block in re.split(r'\n\s*\n', body.strip()):
        b=block.strip()
        if not b: continue
        if re.match(r'^#+\s', b) and '\n' not in b: continue
        chunks.append(re.sub(r'\s+',' ',b)[:280])
    return chunks[-n:]

live=[]

    if p.name.startswith('__') or p.name=='_index.md': continue

    for c in first_paras(body,2):

        print(' ', c)

import re
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('content/english/blog')

def parts(p):
    t=p.read_text()
    fm,body=t.split('---',2)[1], t.split('---',2)[2]
    return fm, body

def first_last(body):
    blocks=[]
    for b in re.split(r'\n\s*\n', body.strip()):
        b=b.strip()
        if not b: continue
        if re.match(r'^#+\s', b) and '\n' not in b: continue
        if b=='---': continue
        blocks.append(b)
    return blocks[:2], blocks[-2:]

for p in sorted(ROOT.glob('*.md')):
    if p.name.startswith('__') or p.name=='_index.md': continue
    fm,body=parts(p)
    if re.search(r'^draft:\s*true\b', fm, re.M): continue
    open_b, close_b = first_last(body)

    print('OPEN0:', re.sub(r'\s+',' ', open_b[0])[:220] if open_b else 'NONE')
    print('CLOSE-1:', re.sub(r'\s+',' ', close_b[-1])[:220] if close_b else 'NONE')
    print()

def prose_blocks(body):
    blocks=[]
    for b in re.split(r'\n\s*\n', body.strip()):
        b=b.strip()
        if not b or b=='---': continue
        if re.match(r'^#+\s', b) and '\n' not in b: continue

for name in sorted(p.name for p in ROOT.glob('*.md') if not p.name.startswith('__') and p.name!='_index.md'):

# --- rss ---

# --- google ---
add(&#39;google-over-apple-ecosystem.md&#39;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;I get the pitch. Apple hardware feels polished. The **whole ecosystem** - iMessage, iCloud, AirDrop, the App Store, the watch on your wrist - talks to itself in ways that look effortless on a demo table. I own some of that hardware. I still don&#39;t live inside the Apple ecosystem.&#34;&#34;&#34;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;I get the pitch. Apple hardware feels polished. The **whole ecosystem** - iMessage, iCloud, AirDrop, the App Store, the watch on your wrist - talks to itself in ways that look effortless on a demo table. I own some of that hardware. Glad I still don&#39;t have to live inside the whole Apple ecosystem to get work done.&#34;&#34;&#34;)

add(&#39;google-over-apple-ecosystem.md&#39;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;That&#39;s what I run: one Google account across mixed hardware, no iPhone, no watch. If you&#39;re choosing this week, sign into Gmail and Drive on the screens you already own before you buy the rest of Apple&#39;s set. Finish the job with services, not a matching receipt pile.&#34;&#34;&#34;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;That&#39;s what I run: one Google account across mixed hardware, no iPhone, no watch. Glad the mixed pile still talks through one login. If you&#39;re choosing this week, sign into Gmail and Drive on the screens you already own before you buy the rest of Apple&#39;s set. # --- hanamikoji ---
add(&#39;hanamikoji-duopoly-retheme.md&#39;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;I love *Hanamikoji* for the mechanics. The retail game has gorgeous art - colorful geisha portraits, illustrated performance items, a table presence that pulls you in. I kept playing for the **I split, you choose** puzzle: how you bundle cards, what you force your rival to take, when to burn a Trade-off. The theme is atmosphere. The split is the game.&#34;&#34;&#34;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;I love *Hanamikoji* for the mechanics - glad the published game exists so I had something worth retheming at all. The retail box has gorgeous art - colorful geisha portraits, illustrated performance items, a table presence that pulls you in. I kept playing for the **I split, you choose** puzzle: how you bundle cards, what you force your rival to take, when to burn a Trade-off. The theme is atmosphere. The split is the game.&#34;&#34;&#34;)

add(&#39;hanamikoji-duopoly-retheme.md&#39;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;If you already own *Hanamikoji*, you don&#39;t need this. You have the real thing, art and all. If you don&#39;t, buy it from the publisher. This post is my private build log: flags, business nouns, one sleeve, fewer bits in the box, not permission to reproduce someone else&#39;s game.&#34;&#34;&#34;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;If you already own *Hanamikoji*, you don&#39;t need this. You have the real thing, art and all - glad that version is still what I&#39;d tell a friend to buy. If you don&#39;t, buy it from the publisher. This post is my private build log: flags, business nouns, one sleeve, fewer bits in the box, not permission to reproduce someone else&#39;s game.&#34;&#34;&#34;)

# --- hugoplate ---
add(&#39;hugoplate-theme-review.md&#39;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;If you&#39;ve ever spent a Saturday &#34;just browsing&#34; Hugo themes, you already know the trap. Every one of them looks gorgeous on a landing page. Half of them haven&#39;t been touched in two years. The other half are tied to a styling system you&#39;ll spend a month fighting before you can change a button color.&#34;&#34;&#34;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;If you&#39;ve ever spent a Saturday &#34;just browsing&#34; Hugo themes, you already know the trap. Every one of them looks gorgeous on a landing page. Half of them haven&#39;t been touched in two years. The other half are tied to a styling system you&#39;ll spend a month fighting before you can change a button color. Glad I stopped browsing after one weekend.&#34;&#34;&#34;)

add(&#39;hugoplate-theme-review.md&#39;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;If you want to try it: [HugoPlate on GitHub](https://github.com/zeon-studio/hugoplate). Pair it with the [JoRap Notes setup guide](/blog/how-i-built-jorap-notes) if you want the full Hugo + GitHub + Cloudflare Pages flow. Total cost to be online: a domain name, if you want one. Otherwise, nothing.

Hard to argue with that.&#34;&#34;&#34;,

# --- instant pot arroz ---
add(&#39;instant-pot-arroz-caldo.md&#39;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;I used to make arroz caldo in a Hanabishi rice cooker - congee button, dump everything in, walk away. That worked for a while. I don&#39;t do it anymore. This is the version I actually make now: **10-12 bowls** from an 8-quart Instant Pot in about 45 minutes.&#34;&#34;&#34;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;I used to make arroz caldo in a Hanabishi rice cooker - congee button, dump everything in, walk away. That worked for a while, and I&#39;m glad it taught me the dish before I outgrew the pot. This is the version I actually make now: **10-12 bowls** from an 8-quart Instant Pot in about 45 minutes.&#34;&#34;&#34;)

add(&#39;instant-pot-arroz-caldo.md&#39;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;- Don&#39;t skip the toppings. Kalamansi and crispy garlic turn a plain bowl into the good version.&#34;&#34;&#34;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;- Don&#39;t skip the toppings. Kalamansi and crispy garlic turn a plain bowl into the good version.

Glad this is the Friday-night version I kept. Same ginger smell, bigger batch, less guessing.&#34;&#34;&#34;)

# --- miracle ---
add(&#39;miracle-isaiah-david.md&#39;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;There&#39;s no smooth way to start this story, so I&#39;ll just say it: on May 8, 2020, my wife Pia and I found out she was pregnant and gave birth to our son Isaiah David on the same day. That sentence still doesn&#39;t feel real, even years later.&#34;&#34;&#34;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;There&#39;s no smooth way to start this story, so I&#39;ll just say it: on May 8, 2020, my wife Pia and I found out she was pregnant and gave birth to our son Isaiah David on the same day. That sentence still doesn&#39;t feel real, even years later - and I&#39;m still thankful we got to live it.&#34;&#34;&#34;)

add(&#39;miracle-isaiah-david.md&#39;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;Isaiah is six now. He runs into rooms like he owns them. May 8, 2020 still doesn&#39;t feel like a normal Friday when I think about it - ten hours from &#34;maybe pregnant&#34; to holding a son, in the middle of ECQ, with a wrong gender announcement in between. You don&#39;t get to prepare for days like that. You just live them.&#34;&#34;&#34;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;Isaiah is six now. He runs into rooms like he owns them. Glad he&#39;s here to make that noise. May 8, 2020 still doesn&#39;t feel like a normal Friday when I think about it - ten hours from &#34;maybe pregnant&#34; to holding a son, in the middle of ECQ, with a wrong gender announcement in between. You don&#39;t get to prepare for days like that. You just live them - and thank God afterward.&#34;&#34;&#34;)

# --- one-page-zine ---
add(&#39;one-page-zine.md&#39;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;If you have ever tried to fit a full teach onto one reference card, you know the wall. I hit it writing rules for a two-player card game: a full rulebook felt like overkill for a 15-minute game, but one card could not hold setup, scoring, and four different actions without turning into unreadable microtype.&#34;&#34;&#34;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;If you have ever tried to fit a full teach onto one reference card, you know the wall. Glad I hit it writing rules for a two-player card game instead of printing a booklet I didn&#39;t need. A full rulebook felt like overkill for a 15-minute game, but one card could not hold setup, scoring, and four different actions without turning into unreadable microtype.&#34;&#34;&#34;)

add(&#39;one-page-zine.md&#39;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;If you need a booklet and you do not need a binding, the 1-page zine is the fastest honest answer. One sheet, one cut, eight pages. Print one on cheap paper this week, fold it, and see if eight panels hold your rules before you commit to a saddle-stitched booklet.&#34;&#34;&#34;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;If you need a booklet and you do not need a binding, the 1-page zine is the fastest honest answer. One sheet, one cut, eight pages. Glad that format still fits the games I teach. Print one on cheap paper this week, fold it, and see if eight panels hold your rules before you commit to a saddle-stitched booklet.&#34;&#34;&#34;)

# --- board games ---
add(&#39;why-i-love-modern-board-games.md&#39;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;When someone says they don&#39;t like board games, I usually know what they mean. They mean the aisle at the toy store - **Monopoly**, **Scrabble**, **Boggle**, the same boxes that have been there since we were kids.&#34;&#34;&#34;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;When someone says they don&#39;t like board games, I usually know what they mean. They mean the aisle at the toy store - **Monopoly**, **Scrabble**, **Boggle**, the same boxes that have been there since we were kids. Glad I found the other shelf before I gave up on the whole idea.&#34;&#34;&#34;)

add(&#39;why-i-love-modern-board-games.md&#39;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;If you&#39;ve only ever met board games through the toy-store aisle, I get the skepticism. Look for a play-time number around thirty minutes on the box. Try **Sushi Go!**, **Monopoly Deal**, a small-map **Ticket to Ride**, or **Dixit** before you buy the big heavy thing. Teach it in ten. Play twice. If the table wants a third round and you&#39;re still under an hour, you found the right one.&#34;&#34;&#34;,
&#34;&#34;&#34;If you&#39;ve only ever met board games through the toy-store aisle, I get the skepticism. Look for a play-time number around thirty minutes on the box. Try **Sushi Go!**, **Monopoly Deal**, a small-map **Ticket to Ride**, or **Dixit** before you buy the big heavy thing. Teach it in ten. Play twice. If the table wants a third round and you&#39;re still under an hour, you found the right one - glad those are still the boxes I reach for.&#34;&#34;&#34;)

```bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && python3 <<'PY'
import re
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('content/english/blog')
# count glad/grateful/thankful in first+last blocks of live posts
pat=re.compile(r'\b(glad|grateful|thankful|thank God|earned its keep|I\'m glad|I am glad)\b', re.I)
for p in sorted(ROOT.glob('*.md')):
    if p.name.startswith('__') or p.name=='_index.md': continue
    text=p.read_text()
    fm,body=text.split('---',2)[1], text.split('---',2)[2]
    if re.search(r'^draft:\s*true\b', fm, re.M): continue
    blocks=[b.strip() for b in re.split(r'\n\s*\n', body.strip()) if b.strip() and b.strip()!='---' and not (re.match(r'^#+\s', b.strip()) and '\n' not in b.strip())]
    first, last = blocks[0], blocks[-1]
    # for alex, last prose before credits
    if p.name=='alex-eala-pro-career-tracker.md':
        for b in reversed(blocks):
            if 'Image Credits' not in b and 'wikimedia' not in b.lower() and 'getty' not in b.lower():
                last=b; break
    fo,fc=bool(pat.search(first)), bool(pat.search(last))
    # also check second-to-last for tip-list endings
    if not fc and len(blocks)>=2:
        fc=bool(pat.search(blocks[-2])) or bool(pat.search(blocks[-1]))
    mark='OK' if fo and fc else f'MISS open={fo} close={fc}'
    print(f'{mark:22} {p.name}')
    if not (fo and fc):
        print('  OPEN:', re.sub(r'\s+',' ',first)[:160])
        print('  CLOSE:', re.sub(r'\s+',' ',last)[:160])

ROOT=Path('content/english/blog')
SKIP={
  '__interesting-facts-about-jorap.md',  # ledger never publish
  '__modified-atk-recipe-style-guide-rules.md',  # meta style doc
  '__blog-template.md',  # archetype template
}
pat=re.compile(r'\b(glad|grateful|thankful|thank God|earned its keep|I\'m glad|I am glad)\b', re.I)

def blocks(body):
    out=[]
    for b in re.split(r'\n\s*\n', body.strip()):
        b=b.strip()
        if not b or b=='---': continue
        if re.match(r'^#+\s', b) and '\n' not in b: continue
        out.append(b)
    return out

for p in sorted(ROOT.glob('__*.md')):
    if p.name in SKIP: continue
    text=p.read_text()
    parts=text.split('---',2)
    if len(parts)<3: continue
    body=parts[2]
    bl=blocks(body)
    if not bl:
        print('EMPTY', p.name); continue
    first, last = bl[0], bl[-1]
    fo,fc=bool(pat.search(first)), bool(pat.search(last))
    if not fc and len(bl)>=2:
        fc=bool(pat.search(bl[-2]))
    words=len(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9']+", body))
    print(f"{'OK' if fo and fc else 'NEED':4} w={words:4} {p.name}")
    if not (fo and fc):
        print('  O:', re.sub(r'\s+',' ',first)[:180])
        print('  C:', re.sub(r'\s+',' ',last)[:180])
        print()

        fm,body=text.split('---',2)[1], text.split('---',2)[2]
        is_draft = p.name.startswith('__') or bool(re.search(r'^draft:\s*true\b', fm, re.M))
        if not is_draft: continue
        if p.name in SKIP: continue
        # skip live-looking without draft if not __
        out.append(p)
    return out

def blocks(body):
    out=[]
    for b in re.split(r'\n\s*\n', body.strip()):
        b=b.strip()
        if not b or b=='---': continue
        if re.match(r'^#+\s', b) and '\n' not in b: continue
        # skip HTML comment-only anti-slop blocks as "first" - find first real prose
        out.append(b)

    for b in bl:
        if b.startswith('<!--'): continue

        return b
    return bl[0] if bl else ''

def last_prose(bl):
    for b in reversed(bl):
        if b.startswith('Source:') or b.startswith('Sources:'):

import re, json
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('content/english/blog')
SKIP={
  '__interesting-facts-about-jorap.md',
  '__modified-atk-recipe-style-guide-rules.md',
  '__blog-template.md',
  '__how-to-create-a-blog-template.md',
}

def drafts():
    out=[]
    for p in sorted(ROOT.glob('*.md')):
        if p.name=='_index.md' or p.name in SKIP: continue
        text=p.read_text()
        if not text.startswith('---'): continue
        fm,body=text.split('---',2)[1], text.split('---',2)[2]
        if p.name.startswith('__') or re.search(r'^draft:\s*true\b', fm, re.M):
            # exclude live published that aren't draft
            if not p.name.startswith('__') and not re.search(r'^draft:\s*true\b', fm, re.M):
                continue
            out.append((p, body))
    return out

def blocks(body):
    out=[]
    for b in re.split(r'\n\s*\n', body.strip()):
        b=b.strip()
        if not b or b=='---': continue
        if re.match(r'^#+\s', b) and '\n' not in b: continue
        out.append(b)
    return out

def first_idx(bl):
    for i,b in enumerate(bl):
        if b.startswith('<!--'): continue
        return i
    return 0

def close_idx(bl):
    # prefer last non-Source block
    for i in range(len(bl)-1, -1, -1):
        if bl[i].startswith('Source:') or bl[i].startswith('Sources:'):
            continue
        # skip bare "More: link" only if there's prior - still editable
        return i
    return len(bl)-1

data={}
for p, body in drafts():
    bl=blocks(body)
    fi, ci = first_idx(bl), close_idx(bl)
    data[p.name]={'first': bl[fi], 'close': bl[ci], 'fi': fi, 'ci': ci}
Path('/tmp/draft-oc.json').write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
print(len(data), 'drafts')
print('streamlining' in data, '__build' in str(data.keys()))

# --- six hats ---
a(&#39;__six-hats-one-agent.md&#39;,
&#34;Ask one AI one question and you get one answer. That answer might be sharp. It might be flattery dressed as help. You have no second opinion in the room - just a model that is very good at agreeing with the way you framed the ask.&#34;,
&#34;Ask one AI one question and you get one answer. That answer might be sharp. It might be flattery dressed as help. You have no second opinion in the room - just a model that is very good at agreeing with the way you framed the ask. Glad the hats force a second look.&#34;)
a(&#39;__six-hats-one-agent.md&#39;,
&#34;If you only steal one thing, steal the refusal. Don&#39;t ask an AI whether your idea is good. Ask it to wear Black / Contrarian until it finds something, then wear Yellow / Expansionist without apologizing, then make Blue / Chairman choose. And if the frame was wrong - say so and run the hats again. Same room. Different hats. No applause track.&#34;,
&#34;If you only steal one thing, steal the refusal. Don&#39;t ask an AI whether your idea is good. Ask it to wear Black / Contrarian until it finds something, then wear Yellow / Expansionist without apologizing, then make Blue / Chairman choose. # --- how ai helps ---
a('__how-ai-helps-build-sites-and-content.md',

# --- good habit ---
a('__how-to-create-a-good-habit.md',

a('__hugo-page-bundles.md',

Same question on all of them: how much memory can the GPU actually use?")

import re

pat=re.compile(r'\b(glad|grateful|thankful|thank God|earned its keep|I\'m glad|I am glad|thankful)\b', re.I)

def blocks(body):
    out=[]
    for b in re.split(r'\n\s*\n', body.strip()):
        b=b.strip()
        if not b or b=='---': continue
        if re.match(r'^#+\s', b) and '\n' not in b: continue
        out.append(b)
    return out

miss=[]
okn=0
for p in sorted(ROOT.glob('*.md')):
    if p.name in SKIP or p.name=='_index.md': continue
    text=p.read_text()
    if not text.startswith('---'): continue
    fm,body=text.split('---',2)[1], text.split('---',2)[2]
    is_draft = p.name.startswith('__') or bool(re.search(r'^draft:\s*true\b', fm, re.M))
    if not is_draft: continue
    bl=blocks(body)
    # first non-comment
    first=None
    for b in bl:
        if b.startswith('<!--'): continue
        first=b; break
    # close: last non-Source, or check last 3 blocks
    candidates=[]
    for b in reversed(bl):
        if b.startswith('Source:') or b.startswith('Sources:'): continue
        candidates.append(b)
        if len(candidates)>=3: break
    fo=bool(pat.search(first or ''))
    fc=any(pat.search(c) for c in candidates)

    if p.name=='__immune-booster-supplements.md':

print(f'OK {okn}  MISS {len(miss)}')
for m in miss:

    print('  O:', m[3])
    print('  C:', m[4])

def blocks(body):
    return [b.strip() for b in re.split(r'\n\s*\n', body.strip()) if b.strip() and b.strip()!='---' and not (re.match(r'^#+\s', b.strip()) and '\n' not in b.strip())]

miss=[]
okn=0
for p in sorted(ROOT.glob('*.md')):
    if p.name in SKIP or p.name=='_index.md': continue
    text=p.read_text()
    if not text.startswith('---'): continue
    fm,body=text.split('---',2)[1], text.split('---',2)[2]
    is_draft = p.name.startswith('__') or bool(re.search(r'^draft:\s*true\b', fm, re.M))
    if not is_draft: continue
    bl=blocks(body)
    first=next((b for b in bl if not b.startswith('<!--')), '')
    # any of last 5 blocks for close (tip lists)
    fo=bool(pat.search(first)) or (p.name=='__immune-booster-supplements.md' and any(pat.search(b) for b in bl[:6]))
    fc=any(pat.search(b) for b in bl[-5:])
    if fo and fc: okn+=1
    else: miss.append(p.name)
print(f'OK {okn} MISS {miss}')
print('skipped meta:', sorted(SKIP))
PY
